entries.source: Twister Ride in Alanya. Fast inflatable group water attraction for 4–8 guests. 10–12 minutes of speed, splashes and adrenaline on the Mediterranean Sea. From €170.
entries.translation: Twister Ride in Alanya. Fast inflatable group water attraction for 4–8 guests. 10–12 minutes of speed, splashes and adrenaline on the Mediterranean Sea. From €170.

entries.source: The ultimate group inflatable water attraction full of speed and adrenaline
entries.translation: The ultimate group inflatable water attraction full of speed and adrenaline

entries.source: Experience one of the most exciting group water sports activities in Alanya. Hold tight, enjoy sharp turns, huge splashes and unforgettable moments on the Mediterranean Sea with friends and family.
entries.translation: Experience one of the most exciting group water sports activities in Alanya. Hold tight, enjoy sharp turns, huge splashes and unforgettable moments on the Mediterranean Sea with friends and family.

entries.source: Twister Ride is a private towable-water attraction for groups of four to eight participants.
entries.translation: Twister Ride is a private towable-water attraction for groups of four to eight participants.

entries.source: Guests sit around the large circular inflatable, hold the safety handles and are pulled by a motorboat inside the designated activity area.
entries.translation: Guests sit around the large circular inflatable, hold the safety handles and are pulled by a motorboat inside the designated activity area.

entries.source: No previous experience is normally required. Before departure, the team explains seating, grip, body position, safe behavior during turns and what to do if someone falls into the water.
entries.translation: No previous experience is normally required. Before departure, the team explains seating, grip, body position, safe behavior during turns and what to do if someone falls into the water.

entries.source: The booked ride lasts approximately 10–12 minutes. Speed, turns and intensity are controlled by the boat crew according to the group and sea conditions.
entries.translation: The booked ride lasts approximately 10–12 minutes. Speed, turns and intensity are controlled by the boat crew according to the group and sea conditions.
